name: ALT V-UP
introduce: Start in the lying position with your legs extend and arms at your sides. \n\nSimultaneously lift your left leg and your upper body up off the ground, and use your right hand to touch your toes. Repeat with the other leg.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep the other leg on the ground when lifting one leg up.
Please make sure your lower back leave the ground when touching your toes.
It develops your abs and strengthens your core.
